title: A shared label stays written when one of its links is hidden, and a kept row's doubly decided field is written
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd (no database needed).
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: A label two blocks' buttons print stays in the copy when one link is hidden; R10b and R24 both pass.
Every link printing a shared label hidden still fails R10b.
A field of a kept row that the decision writes and hides is written; a row not shown stays as the planner left it.

tests: a label several blocks print stays written when its link is hidden: R10b and R24 agree, and no normalizer hides it
R10b a hidden link still fails when every link using the shared label slot is hidden
a written field of a row the decision keeps is no longer hidden; the rest of the decision stays
a row the decision does not show, a slot it only hides and a dropped page stay as the planner left them
